grammar.environment.invalid.title: Invalid phonological environment
grammar.environment.invalid.explanation: The environment expression could not be parsed and is ignored as a restriction.
grammar.environment.invalid.guidance: In Grammar > Environments, correct the expression for phonological environment '{subject}' if the allomorph must be restricted; otherwise report a valid syntax the parser rejects.

conversion.unsegmentable-form.title: Allomorph form cannot be segmented
conversion.unsegmentable-form.explanation: The substrate allomorph cannot be divided using the imported phoneme and boundary inventory.
conversion.unsegmentable-form.guidance: In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, check its spelling against the inventory and use the warning's position detail to locate the unresolved material.

grammar.msa.no-rule-form-allomorphs.title: Analysis has no usable affix form
grammar.msa.no-rule-form-allomorphs.explanation: This analysis has no usable affix-form allomorph.
grammar.msa.no-rule-form-allomorphs.guidance: In Lexicon > Lexicon Edit, inspect Allomorphs, their forms, Morph Type and Environments. Review the specific finding for each rejected form.

grammar.phoneme.nfd-collision.title: Phoneme representation collision
grammar.phoneme.nfd-collision.explanation: A phoneme spelling collides with an earlier phoneme or boundary after Unicode normalization.
grammar.phoneme.nfd-collision.guidance: In Grammar > Phonemes, compare the named phoneme's In Orthography as values. Correct an unintended duplicate; retain a linguistically intentional distinction and report the limitation.

migration.inferred-segment-with-feature-.title: Unlisted character matches a feature class
migration.inferred-segment-with-feature-.explanation: A character inferred from an allomorph has no authored phonological features yet matches a feature-defined natural class.
migration.inferred-segment-with-feature-.guidance: If the character is a language phoneme, define its In Orthography as and Phonological Features in Grammar > Phonemes. Otherwise correct the unintended allomorph spelling in Lexicon > Lexicon Edit.
